reviewer.modelIdentitySource: Trusted active orchestration message from the parent/root host explicitly reported that the spawn requested gpt-5.6-sol while the active model was GPT-6.1 Sol.

features.1: Army formations: arrange troops into lines, wedges, squares or loose skirmish groups.
features.4: Morale: isolated or badly damaged squads can retreat or surrender.
features.9: Capturable siege engines: defeat their crews and claim the equipment.
features.10: Ambush orders: conceal troops and set conditions for revealing them.

mountedBrowserEvidence.qualification: The results blob is unchanged at root, but TacticsTools.ts, src/main.ts and tests/tactics-tools.test.ts changed after the capture commit. Current UI proof comes from the 2920-pass suite and exact UI/test blobs through root.

combatTestAssertions.fullName: combat tactics encounters line preserves stable slots, routes around a building, and regroups after a casualty
combat tactics encounters wedge preserves stable slots, routes around a building, and regroups after a casualty
combat tactics encounters square preserves stable slots, routes around a building, and regroups after a casualty
combat tactics encounters loose preserves stable slots, routes around a building, and regroups after a casualty
combat tactics encounters assigns the same formation destinations for arbitrary entity-array and command-ID order

features.executedBehavior: Each named formation is issued through the command path, mixed troops move into it, and survivors regroup after a casualty.

combatTestAssertions.fullName: combat tactics encounters an isolated wounded fighter retreats while allied support recovers morale
combat tactics encounters surrounded broken troops surrender without healing or changing their original definition

features.executedBehavior: An isolated half-health fighter retreats, an allied-support control recovers morale, and a badly damaged low-morale fighter surrounded from three directions surrenders and changes command ownership.
features.interpretation: The game's controllable combat unit is the morale-bearing actor; the wording does not require a separate multi-entity squad object.

combatTestAssertions.fullName: combat tactics encounters crew deaths leave neutral equipment which channels capture, retains stats and obeys its new owner
combat tactics encounters an enemy guard contests siege capture until it leaves the equipment

features.executedBehavior: A normal attack defeats the crew without destroying the engine; the engine becomes neutral, completes a capture channel, restores its crew, preserves its definition and obeys its new owner.
features.mountedBrowserQualification: The browser fixture starts with an authored uncrewed engine and proves capture UI only; crew defeat is established by the executed encounter test.

combatTestAssertions.fullName: combat tactics encounters ambush troops remain concealed, withhold fire, and reveal on the selected trigger
combat tactics encounters scout detection, manual release and destroyed concealment expose an ambush without leaking its trigger
combat tactics encounters formation, ambush and combat history replay to the same saved checksum

features.executedBehavior: A normal ambush order stores a target class and radius, conceals the troop from enemy observation and targeting, withholds fire, then reveals and attacks when the chosen enemy enters the radius.
